content: Every genuine work of art has as much reason for being as the earth and the sun.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Authentic art is not a decorative luxury; it is a fundamental manifestation of universal necessity, as natural and inevitable as a sunrise.
practicalInsight: Honor your creative impulses as legitimate expressions of nature seeking form through you.
reflectionPrompt: What creative endeavor are you called to birth into the world without apology?
